text.en: VideoMAE is row 21 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Video area.
text.zh: VideoMAE 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 21 行，所属领域为“视频”。

text.en: The annual table associates VideoMAE with “VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training”.
text.zh: 年度表把 VideoMAE 与论文《VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Zhan Tong, Limin Wang”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Zhan Tong（官方页拼写）、Limin Wang（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Zhan Tong, Limin Wang”。
